name: African Union (1970–2010)
description: Three horizontal bands of green, white and green, the white band separated from the green by narrow gold stripes, charged at the centre with the OAU emblem: a gold map of Africa within a ring encircled by palm fronds and seven red rings.
history: Adopted by the Organisation of African Unity in 1970 and carried over by its successor, the African Union, which re-adopted it in 2004. Replaced at the AU's 14th Assembly on 31 January 2010 by the green flag with a gold map of the continent inside a ring of stars.

features.symbolism: green for hope and unity, gold for the continent's wealth, white for purity

features.role: map of Africa within a ring and palm fronds
